title: 8/28/2006 Peter Schiff On Kudlow & Co: Predicts The US Economic Collapse
summary: A 2006 television appearance in which Peter Schiff warns on Kudlow & Co about the housing bubble and an approaching US economic collapse.
why: Offered as an example of someone who publicly predicted the financial crisis ahead of time, in arguments about economic forecasting.

quote.text: There have been people like Peter Schiff warning about the recession and specifically saying when it will happen and how long it will last
